question: Calculate the duration of each track, classify them as short, medium, or long, output the minimum and maximum time for each kind (in minutes) and the total revenue for each category, group by the category.
sql:
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT 
    MIN(Milliseconds) as min_ms,
    MAX(Milliseconds) as max_ms,
    AVG(Milliseconds) as avg_ms
  FROM Track
),
boundaries AS (
  SELECT 
    (min_ms + avg_ms) / 2.0 as short_max,
    (avg_ms + max_ms) / 2.0 as medium_max
  FROM stats
),
track_with_class AS (
  SELECT 
    t.TrackId,
    t.Milliseconds,
    t.Milliseconds / 60000.0 as duration_minutes,
    CASE 
      WHEN t.Milliseconds <= b.short_max THEN 'short'
      WHEN t.Milliseconds <= b.medium_max THEN 'medium'
      ELSE 'long'
    END as category
  FROM Track t, boundaries b
)
SELECT 
  tc.category,
  MIN(tc.duration_minutes) as min_duration_minutes,
  MAX(tc.duration_minutes) as max_duration_minutes,
  COALESCE(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 0) as total_revenue
FROM track_with_class tc
LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine il ON tc.TrackId = il.TrackId
GROUP BY tc.category
ORDER BY tc.category
